segments.vo: Why choose K J Somaiya College of Engineering?

Established in 1983, it is a leading engineering institute in Mumbai. Your journey happens on a vibrant campus featuring twenty libraries and a twenty acre sports and recreational area. You can even join over twenty clubs.
Experience incredible milestones, like the successful launch of the satellite Somaiya BeliefSat zero by ISRO. Our community is built on innovation and trust.
Explore Somaiya - details on the official website at www.somaiya.edu or email admissions at admissions@somaiya.edu.
